semantics.output_rule: Matching code asserts only its named output; all other outputs are zero. Every other binary scancode drives all outputs zero.
semantics.timing: Outputs reflect current input after combinational settling, without a clock or cycle latency.
semantics.state_initialization: No stored state, initialization, reset, or input history; last two received bytes are supplied externally as scancode.

numeric.arithmetic: None; no signed arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow

verification.independent_oracle: For every binary value from 0 through 65535, separately compare input against each of the four specified codes to form expected {left,down,right,up}.
verification.coverage: Exhaustive binary domain plus directed consecutive arrow-to-arrow and arrow-to-unrecognized transitions to detect retained outputs.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait one simulation time unit for combinational settling.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts; self-checking fatal mismatch and final PASS marker.

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is unspecified by the original problem; verification covers binary inputs only.
